shots.prompt: A charismatic top-tier lawyer, sharp in a tailored suit, confidently closes a multi-million dollar deal in a gleaming, high-rise office overlooking a bustling city at sunset. He smiles, shaking hands.

Rain streaks down a sleek office window at night. A ruthless business partner smirks, presenting forged documents to the shocked lawyer, who realizes he's been meticulously framed. Shadows play on his face.
A once-powerful lawyer, now gaunt and despairing, stares blankly through the bars of a cold, stark prison cell. The faint sound of distant prison chatter echoes through the concrete walls.
A grizzled, weary man in ill-fitting clothes exits a grim prison gate under a desolate grey sky. He clutches a crumpled letter, his face etched with unspeakable grief, his world utterly shattered.
On a rain-slicked city street at night, a broken man collapses against a grimy wall, tears mixing with the rain. Suddenly, a brilliant, ethereal light flashes, engulfing him completely.

The lawyer jolts awake in his luxurious bedroom, exactly ten years younger, the city rain still drumming against the window. He touches his face, a mix of shock and dawning realization washing over him.

A determined lawyer sits at a grand mahogany desk, illuminated by a single lamp, meticulously arranging old photographs of his former business partner and other conspirators. His eyes burn with cold resolve.

In a dimly lit, high-tech office, the lawyer types furiously on a glowing screen, complex legal documents and financial schematics projected around him. He sips coffee, a subtle, dangerous smirk playing on his lips.
